== Notes ==
*This skill removes a hex and then removes a condition.
*Since it has no energy cost and needs an enchanted target, this skill is useful for [[bonder]]s, as well as any [[Protection Prayers]] monk builds that need passive [[energy management]].
*Useful for self-removal of hex spells that trigger on casting a [[spell]], such as [[Shame]], [[Mark of Subversion]] or [[Backfire]], since they can be removed without triggering their effect.
